_help: ENSO impact layers and reports from the Pacific Hazards & Impacts register (ENSO-related reports only; descriptions not published; social-media/monitoring-chat reports marked unverified, without source or link). Each layer shades a country by its strongest report in that theme: impact > response > watch. 'impacts' maps a country code to its reports; 'themes' says which layers list a report ('drought' reports are listed in the drought layers' popups).
